summary: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VIII filed an 8-K reporting completion of its IPO on August 31, 2026. The SPAC sold 28.75 million units at $10.00 each, including full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment, for $287.5 million gross proceeds. Concurrently, it completed a private placement of 8 million warrants at $1.00 each to the sponsor and underwriter representative, raising $8 million. Proceeds of $287.5 million, including deferred underwriting discount, were deposited into a trust account. An audited balance sheet was filed. Watch for subsequent business combination announcement and shareholder redemption dynamics.
